Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 4/9, 4/7 aur 4/5 hai, kyunki teeno mein 4 hisse, par 1/9 ka hissa sabse chhota aur 1/5 ka sabse bada; isliye 4/9, phir 4/7, phir 4/5. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
pata nahi, aap batao

Teen ek jaisi chocolate se chaar-chaar hisse liye, par 9 mein kati chocolate ke hisse sabse patle the, aur 5 mein kati ke sabse mote; chaar patle hisse kam hote hain, chaar mote zyada. Yahan tak saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Anjali aur Imran ke paas ek jaise ribbon hain. Anjali apna ribbon 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, aur Imran apna ribbon 6 mein kaatkar 5 leta hai. Dono apne liye hue hisse jodkar ek ribbon banate hain. Kiska ribbon lamba banega, Anjali ka ya Imran ka?

director.text: Anjali

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Dono ne paanch-paanch liye; ab socho ki 6 mein kate ribbon ka ek hissa bada hai ya 12 mein kate ka. Anjali ke paas ribbon ka 5/12 hai aur Imran ke paas 5/6, toh kiska ribbon lamba hai?

Sahi jawab, kyunki dono ke paanch-paanch hisse, par Imran ka har hissa Anjali ke hisse ka do guna hai. Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Dono mein poore pizza se bas ek-ek hissa kam hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Dono ki kami dekho: line ke ek taraf 7 gap hain, doosri taraf 9, aur dono mein ek-ek gap ki kami hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?

director.text: 8/9 wala

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 8/9 mein bas 1/9 ki kami hai, 6/7 mein 1/7 ki, aur 1/9 ki kami chhoti hai. Ab poore paath ko yaad karke bas ek sawaal aur karna hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
12/7 nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Iska jawab hai 7/12, kyunki dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pehle wale step se pata chala

Achha, theek hai. Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse hon, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Phir yeh dekha ki neeche ka number same ho toh hisse ek size ke hote hain, aur upar ka number, yaani hisson ki ginti, faisla karta hai. Aakhir mein yeh dekha ki upar ka number same ho toh ginti barabar hoti hai, aur tab hisse ka size batata hai ki kaunsa zyada hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
